observation.visible_scene: A dim, smoke-filled close-up of a metal wok holding a stir-fry mix: sliced mushrooms, orange/yellow/red bell-pepper strips and green onion pieces. Steam rises steadily throughout. A single small green fragment clings to the upper inner wall of the wok.
visible_changes: At the start the food is pooled at the lower-right of the tilted wok while steam billows above it.
The wok's apparent angle shifts toward horizontal and the food slides along the bottom toward the center/left.
The food then climbs up the left inner wall with growing motion blur.
In the final frames the vegetables are lifted over the left rim as an airborne, blurred cascade, leaving the right side of the wok dark and empty.
The stuck green fragment stays on the wall the whole time, moving only in screen position as the wok/food reorient.
outside_clip_unknowns: What or who moves the wok or causes the toss.
Whether the airborne food returns to the wok after the last frame.
The cooking steps before t=0 and after t=3.2s.
uncertain_details: Whether the change in wok orientation is physical wok motion or camera motion (background too dark to confirm).
The exact moment the toss begins versus a continuous slide.
